CustomField.formula: CASE( opportunity_type__c , "買取のみ", CASE(phase_for_purchase__c, "完了", 1, "不成約", 1, 0), "販売のみ", CASE( phase_for_sell__c , "完了", 1, "不成約", 1, 0), "買取・販売",CASE(phase_for_purchase__c, "完了", 1, "不成約", 1, 0)*CASE( phase_for_sell__c , "完了", 1, "不成約", 1, 0), "その他", CASE( phase_for_other__c , "完了", 1, "中止", 1, 0), 0) = 1
